text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...After this race,
there is a place I must go."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
With victory in hand,
there are words I want to tell that person.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yo, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What is it, "Empress"?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, don't try to stir up trouble... Miss "Monster."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, what are you pouting for?
You're the one who picked the fight in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Brian.
How do you plan on running from here on out?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if you realize it or not,
but your running influences people, for better or worse.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: And I just happen to be one of them.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Are you prepared to shoulder the burden?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I'll get stronger for that very reason.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Because I, too, am an Umamusume
influenced by someone else.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
This is the Twinkle Series.
A stage where only those with true conviction can gather.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because we are resolved to keep running
that we continue to take on every challenge.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hah, I see.
So you've steeled your resolve, then.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll keep challenging myself too.
I have zero intention of running a boring race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Even if nobody else is chasing after you,
I'll still be coming for your head."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Now then... let's have our one-on-one duel.
Until one of us completely withers away.
